mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpDsPckpaprDesignSeedBizManagePopList*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'NW','등록', 'IG','진행중', 'ED','종료', 'FY','종결', 'GB','반려', '오류') AS RECV_TEXT, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEXT, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS BUYER_TEXT, NVL(TRIM(A.IMAGE_KEY),'N') AS IMAGE_KEY, DECODE(A.USE_FLAG,'S','긴급','N','일반','') AS USE_TEXT, DECODE(A.GUBUN_FLAG,'NW','신규','OD','기존','ERR') AS GUBUN, NVL(A.RD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS RD_DATE, NVL(A.MM_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS MM_DATE, NVL(A.EE_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS EE_DATE, NVL(A.DD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS DD_DATE, NVL(A.ES_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS ES_DATE, NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N') AS MM_STATUS, A.MM_REMARK AS MM_REMARK, NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N') AS DD_STATUS, A.DD_REMARK AS DD_REMARK, NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N') AS EE_STATUS, A.EE_REMARK AS EE_REMARK, NVL(A.ES_MK_STATUS,'N') AS ES_MK_STATUS, A.ES_MK_REMARK AS ES_MK_REMARK, NVL(A.ES_PD_STATUS,'N') AS ES_PD_STATUS, A.ES_PD_REMARK AS ES_PD_REMARK, NVL(A.ES_QA_STATUS,'N') AS ES_QA_STATUS, A.ES_QA_REMARK AS ES_QA_REMARK, A.PLANT AS PLANT, A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.OPKG_SEQ AS OPKG_SEQ, A.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.AGENT AS AGENT, A.GUBUN_FLAG AS GUBUN_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG AS USE_FLAG, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N') AS ES_MK1_STATUS, A.ES_MK1_REMARK AS ES_MK1_REMARK, NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N') AS ES_PD1_STATUS, A.ES_PD1_REMARK AS ES_PD1_REMARK, NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N') AS ES_QA1_STATUS, A.ES_QA1_REMARK AS ES_QA1_REMARK, NVL(A.SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG,'N') AS SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG, NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N') AS ES_FI_STATUS, A.ES_FI_REMARK AS ES_FI_REMARK, A.PRODUCT_FLAG AS PRODUCT_FLAG, TRIM(A.MM_BARCODE_NO) AS MM_BARCODE_NO ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE ='M014' AND COMPANY_CODE ='AG' AND FLAG ='Y') AS AG ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE ='M014' AND COMPANY_CODE ='HN' AND FLAG ='Y') AS HN , A.ITEM_NO , (select TEXT1 from icomcod2 where type = 'C011' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRDONG0732' AND CODE = A.ITEM_NO ) AS ITEM_NM FROM DONGOPKG A WHERE A.PLANT = #{st_plant} AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_byca_comorg_code} AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.OPKG_SEQ = #{st_opkg_seq} AND A.RD_DATE = #{st_rd_date} AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no}
